items.title: Smucker (SJM) Q1 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates

items.title: J.M. Smucker shares jump on quarterly earnings beat, raised annual guidance
items.summary: Investing.com -- J.M. Smucker shares rose more than 3% in premarket trading Wednesday after the packaged foods maker reported first-quarter earnings well ahead of expectations and raised its full-year profit guidance above consensus.

items.title: J. M. Smucker (NYSE:SJM) Reports Upbeat Q2 CY2026
items.summary: Packaged foods company J.M Smucker (NYSE:SJM) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 5% year on year to $2.22 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.24 per share was 46.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Stocks to Watch: Nvidia, Intuit, Meta
items.summary: ↘️ Intuit (INTU): The company, known for its tax-preparation and accounting software, forecast slower sales growth in the year ahead as it navigates declines in its desktop business. Shares dropped more than 11% premarket.

items.title: Nvidia Earnings, Inflation Data: What to Watch the Rest of the Week
items.summary: August is winding down, but there's still a lot left for markets to digest. Nvidia reports earnings after the bell today, following the latest inflation data this morning. Then, Kevin Warsh’s first major policy speech as Federal Reserve chairman follows on Friday.
